question: What is the weight of the ball in handball for men?
solution:
The correct answer is **425 to 475 gm**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Handball** is a team sport where players use their hands to hit a small ball into the opponent's goal.
 
• The weight of the ball used in **men's handball** is between **425 to 475 grams**.
 
• **Women's handball** uses a slightly lighter ball, weighing between **325 to 375 grams**.
 
• The official size of the ball for men's handball is about **58-60 cm** in circumference.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 History
 **Handball** has roots tracing back to ancient Greece and Rome.
 
 

 Olympic Inclusion
 **Handball** became an official Olympic sport in the 1936 Berlin Games.
 
 

 Field Dimensions
 A **handball court** is 40 meters long and 20 meters wide.
 
 

 Game Duration
 A standard **handball game** lasts for 60 minutes, divided into two 30-minute halves.
 
 

 Team Composition
 A **handball team** consists of 7 players on the court, including a goalkeeper.
